# Shape outer-shadow controls

Original, independently authored OOXML controls generated by
`tools/shape_shadow_fixture.py`, using the project's original shape-theme
package as a scaffold. No corpus artwork or third-party renderer is included.
`native.pdf` is the reference export of `control.docx`.
`tools/shape_shadow_reference.py` records native PDF colors and source/PDF hashes.

Twenty pages cover absent/inherited/direct/empty effects, direct override,
placeholder colors, rotation and its default, horizontal flips, uniform and
nonuniform group scale, group rotation, outline-only and translucent shapes,
an ellipse, and text plus outline. The recorder also checks four pairs of
identical native regions for precedence/default behavior.

The browser regression compares 15,474 native samples with a maximum six-level
RGB tolerance. Sharp edges are excluded using native neighboring pixels;
this is not an assertion of pixel identity at antialiased boundaries. All
twenty reference/browser page pairs were visually inspected. Package preservation,
body editing, unchanged shape XML, exact undo and export/reopen are checked.
An additional browser case covers an empty custom-path silhouette.

Relevant ECMA-376 Part 1 clauses: 20.1.4.1.11 effectStyle,
20.1.4.1.12 effectStyleLst, 20.1.4.2.8 effectRef, 20.1.8.45 outerShdw.
Nonunit shadow scale, skew, obscured shadows, rotated line shadows, other
effect types and 3D theme effects remain unsupported. Compound-outline shadow
combinations are not established by these native controls.
